name: ReceiptThreads
technicalDescription: The correspondence kept on a receipts record (an open ticket): the detail request Nina drafted and the person marked sent (nothing is really sent yet, TODO), the customer's reply once linked, and internal notes. One row per message, newest last. Not written since 08.11 (the detail request was removed; older data only); ResetReceiptsDay removes a day's rows.

columns.name: bankLineId
columns.description: The transfer the thread belongs to

columns.name: status
columns.description: טיוטה; אושר – לא נשלח = the person pressed send, real sending is a TODO; התקבלה = a linked reply

columns.name: approvalId
columns.description: Approvals row id of the outgoing draft (kind בקשת פירוט)

columns.name: inboundEmailId
columns.description: InboundEmails row id of the reply

columns.name: byName
columns.description: Who wrote or marked it (Nina for her draft)

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).
